newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks moving in late trading.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks moving in late trading.

text.p: After another bad day on Wall Street, most stocks changing hands in late trading on Monday were selling for the price they had closed at, traders said.

For example, Kronos Inc, which fell 5-1/2 points to 17-1/2 during regular trading hours, was trading at the closing price, traders said. Kronos on Monday said it expects second-quarter earnings to be below analysts' projections.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 134,300, compared with 35,800 on Thursday. Session two volume was 8,572,700, while on Thursday it was 828, 326.
